title: DER parse: reject trailing garbage after key decode
description: wp11_soft_key_new_from_der passes idx=0 into wc_EccPrivateKeyDecode / wc_RsaPrivateKeyDecode. After a successful decode the parser advances idx to the end of the parsed structure, but the code does not verify that idx == (word32)derlen. A DER buffer with valid key material followed by arbitrary garbage bytes will be accepted silently. This could mask a buffer construction bug in the caller (e.g. an off-by-one that appends a garbage byte). Fix: after each successful decode, add 'if (idx \!= (word32)derlen) { /* cleanup */ return NULL; }'. Add a test with key DER + one extra trailing byte to confirm rejection.
